utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools all morning. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, is that right? What do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still looking for a few screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and some spare nails. I can keep an ear out if you want to know what else comes in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and keep repeating the plan so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I might still miss a beat, so I appreciate you repeating it. Let me know if I can help with anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep bringing up the repair drive so it stays on everyone’s radar.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you help spread the word and maybe pick up a few supplies if you’re out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can spread the word, and I’ll grab a few supplies if I’m out today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basic supplies—tape, gloves, and some spare screws would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring those by later today. If you want, I can also check whether we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time window are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a huge help. I was thinking a late-morning window, maybe 10 to 12, so it lines up before the afternoon school rush.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window should work well—I can help keep it clear and make sure it wraps before pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to hear the plan clearly—what needs fixing, and when are we heading out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—I’m a bit scattered today. We’re fixing the loose fence panel and the squeaky gate, and I was thinking we head out after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine—let’s keep it simple and go after lunch. Just tell me what tools to bring, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I’m going to tell a few neighbors right away and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — could you also let me know what time and where to bring things? I want to make sure I can get there without missing the handoff.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — if you can bring any tools you already have, plus gloves and a can-do attitude, that would be wonderful. I’ll make sure we’ve got a clear list when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what time and location the repair drive is set for? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I don’t have the time or location noted yet. If you want, I can help figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, let’s figure it out together—once we have the time and place, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — simple is good. I’ll swing by late and lend a hand where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Late is fine, and I’ll keep it easy to manage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand, Mina. What tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer, screwdriver set, and a wrench if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive yet, but I can help keep an eye on where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — just let me know where it’s set up when you spot it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I will — as soon as I spot the repair drive, I’ll let you know exactly where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the repair drive needs tools, I’ve got a few I can lend. Just tell me what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m not sure yet, but I’ll let you know what we end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just holler when you know, and I’ll round up whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to make sure we have the right parts, a clear drop-off time, and enough hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm we already have the parts list and a drop-off time set?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t confirmed either yet, so I’d want to check those before we promise anything. If you have the list, I can help sort out a drop-off time and see if we’ve got enough people.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — I can help connect folks if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules — thank you. I’ll let you know what kind of help we need first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll join in a bit late and help fill any gaps once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll make a quick list and let you know what’s missing. We can fill the gaps together when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can keep an ear out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, Tess. I’ll check our school schedule and see what we can spare, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s lovely, Faye—I’m sure they’ll appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what’s still on their list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m ready to get the repair drive organized with you. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the biggest broken items and make a quick list. Then we can figure out what needs tools, parts, or a pro.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated parts and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated parts and label the boxes. I’ll get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell — I’m putting together the repair drive invite list, and I’d love for you to come by and see if you can help spread the word. If you’re free, I can tell you the time and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help spread the word. What time is it, and what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell! We’re starting at 4:00, and we still need a few extra hands, some basic tools, and anyone who can bring snacks or post the invite around.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are headed for the repair drive—what location should I note first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with the community center. I’ll make the rest clear as we go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve noted the community center as the first stop. Just tell me the next location when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to help sort the repair drive supplies, or are we just checking who’s coming?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s just check who’s coming first, and then we can sort the supplies after. I want to make sure we’ve got the details right before we start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—who’s confirmed so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep getting things together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it around the neighborhood and see who can help out.
